teams.detail: Season over. Eliminated by Cavaliers in Game 7 blowout (94-125, May 17). Best Pistons playoff run in years ends in second round.
Bryan Woo 6 scoreless IP, J-Rod and Colt Emerson (1st MLB HR) homered to snap 3-game skid. Record: 23-26. Next: vs. CHW Wed.
Defending Super Bowl LX champs open 2026 vs. Patriots (Sep 9) — six primetime games on schedule. Bud Clark (S, TCU) signed; Jadarian Price only pick unsigned.
Spring game done (Purple 27, Gold 10). Tyler Robles (K, transfer Texas State) leads kicker competition. Home vs. Iowa Fri Oct 9.
12 of 15 roster spots filled for 2026-27. Hannes Steinbach at NBA Draft Combine in Chicago. May 27 withdrawal deadline key.

headlines.headline: NCAA Expands March Madness to 76 Teams for 2026-27
headlines.detail: Three automatic bids added; portal active as rosters finalize ahead of May 27 NBA Draft withdrawal deadline.

headlines.headline: Wembanyama 41/24 in 2OT: Spurs stun Thunder in WCF Game 1
headlines.detail: San Antonio wins 122-115 in double OT. ECF Game 1: Knicks vs. Cavaliers tonight at MSG, 8:30 PM ET.

headlines.headline: Seahawks open Super Bowl defense vs. Patriots Sept 9; OTAs continue
headlines.detail: Six primetime games on Seattle's 2026 schedule. Rodgers takes second straight day of first-team reps in Pittsburgh.

headlines.headline: Mensah to Miami after settling with Duke; LSU tops portal cycle
headlines.detail: LSU landed Sam Leavitt (No. 1-ranked QB) and Husan Longstreet from USC. Mensah clears path to start for Miami in 2026.
